title: Local filesystem capacity pressure

observation_kinds.name: filesystem_snapshot
observation_kinds.description: One statfs snapshot of one exact filesystem instance through its declared mountpoint

coverage.name: filesystem_statistics
coverage.description: Block, fragment-size, and inode counters for the exact filesystem

scope_kinds.name: host_filesystem
scope_kinds.description: One exact machine, filesystem UUID, filesystem type, and mountpoint

vantages.name: local
vantages.description: Observation from a process on the machine that mounts the filesystem

access_paths.name: mountinfo_statfs
access_paths.description: Mount table selection, identity cross-checks, then statfs on the declared path only

bases.name: kernel_snapshot
bases.description: A bounded local kernel superblock counter snapshot

regimes.name: normal
regimes.description: Read-only observation that triggers no automount and writes nothing

capabilities.name: read_filesystem_statistics
capabilities.description: Resolve the filesystem UUID and read statfs counters for the declared path

disturbance_assumptions: Reading superblock counters does not alter the filesystem
One local statfs snapshot establishes capacity pressure only; it is not storage health, integrity, performance, quota, or growth evidence
